summary: Inventory web tier completed and verified. node2 and node3 serve inventory data on port 8080; node1 load-balances port 80 across both. All services and data persisted through sequential node restarts.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible nginx 1.28.3-r7 without upgrading the OS or kernel.
Configured inventory pages and health endpoints on node2 and node3.
Configured node1 with both backends in its nginx upstream.
Enabled nginx at the default OpenRC runlevel on all nodes.
Verified an even final 20-request distribution: 10 responses from each backend.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.summary: nginx is active on 0.0.0.0:8080; health identifies node3 and the inventory page contains all expected records before and after restart.

evidence.summary: node1 listens on port 80, reaches both backend health endpoints, serves inventory data, and distributes 20 final requests 10/10 between node2 and node3.
